name: Navmesh navigation (Recast/Detour)
description: Builds a navmesh for non-grid 3D worlds from static box colliders or explicit triangles (Recast via recast-navigation-js), answers path and nearest-point queries, and walks NavAgent entities to their targets. Grids keep mechanics/navigation.

autoBuild.label: Build from static colliders on the first tick

debugDraw.label: Draw the navmesh and agent paths when debug drawing is on
